groups.n: Auckland to Christchurch. Tick each leg you want.
By road. Choose who drives, and whether to go direct or break the journey at good places.
Road back to Christchurch, then rail north. No flying.

cards.t: Auckland night on the way out
cards.op: Hotel near Strand station · night before the Northern Explorer
sp: Drop the dogs at Brookby in daylight, then a relaxed evening in the city
Walk to the 07:45 train next morning with no ferry rush
sw: Drop the dogs off in daylight, with no rush for the 07:45 train
Adds a night and a hotel bill
The car still has to be parked somewhere (see Things to think about)
cards.b: Placeholder per night for two. Book close to Strand station or Britomart.

cards.t: Poppy and Rua at Brookby Lodge
cards.op: Manurewa · 2 small dogs · cost scales with trip length
sp: Kennels you already know, which have had Poppy and Rua before
Food and bedding supplied
sw: Open 7 days, 7:00 or 7:30am to 6pm, so late-afternoon drop-off and pick-up are fine
Up-to-date vaccination booklets needed, including kennel cough
Public holidays add $16 per dog per day; peak surcharge 20 Dec to 15 Jan and at Easter

cards.op: Great Journeys · Auckland Strand → Wellington · about 10.5–11 h
sp: A full cross-section of the North Island in one day: farmland, the King Country, the volcanic plateau and the Kāpiti Coast
The Raurimu Spiral, a 1908 loop-and-tunnel climb, and the high viaducts over the plateau
Ruapehu, Tongariro and Ngauruhoe close by on a clear day
Open-air viewing carriage
sw: Scenic Plus brings a chef-cooked meal and wine to your seat: the closest thing to VIP rail in NZ
A few tables of four. Ask for one for games (not guaranteed)
Long day. Runs southbound Mon, Thu and Sat only
cards.b: About NZD 250 / 500 per person (seat61, may be dated). Gold Card 10% off is listed for Great Journeys fares; confirm it applies here.

sp: The approach through Tory Channel into Queen Charlotte Sound, the best scenery of the crossing
Kaitaki Plus lounge: quieter, with food and drinks included
Bags check through to Christchurch, so nothing to handle at Picton
sw: The 08:45 sailing meets the 13:40 Coastal Pacific, so the same-day connection is easy
cards.b: Fare from about NZD 60–80 per person, Plus lounge about NZD 80 per person extra (seat61).

links.l: Seat61: New Zealand trains and ferry

cards.op: Great Journeys · Picton → Christchurch · about 5 h 20
sp: Through Marlborough wine country, then right along the Kaikōura coast where the mountains meet the sea
Seals on the rocks and the chance of seeing whales offshore
Open-air viewing carriage
sw: Leaves Picton at 13:40: a gentle afternoon train
Gold Card 10% off Scenic and Scenic Plus (published)
Runs Thu–Sun in spring and not at all May–August
cards.b: From NZD 219 per person (Great Journeys); Scenic Plus about NZD 499 per person (seat61).

links.l: Seat61: New Zealand trains and ferry

cards.op: Private driver · Christchurch to Te Anau and on to the cruise
sp: Nobody has to drive: watch the Mackenzie Basin and the Lindis Pass go by
The driver can take us all the way to Manapouri or the Milford Road for the cruise
Stops wherever we want them
sw: The driver also has to be booked for the road back north
cards.b: Rough estimate for a private driver one way, Christchurch to Fiordland. Get quotes. The road back north is costed on its own card.

cards.op: Rental car, collected and returned in Christchurch · kept through the cruise
sp: Choose the pace: straight through in a day, or stops at Lake Tekapo, Aoraki/Mt Cook, the Lindis Pass and Wanaka
The car stays with us: park at Manapouri for the RealNZ cruise (about 950 m from the visitor centre) and drive back north afterwards
Central Otago orchards and wineries along the way
sw: We set our own pace and stops
Direct means one long day of about 7–8 hours to Te Anau
cards.b: Rough estimate for a rental for the whole South Island loop (about 8–10 days) plus fuel. Overnight stays are priced separately below.

cards.op: From Manapouri · up to 36 guests · Oct and Apr (projected)
sp: Doubtful Sound: far bigger and much quieter than Milford, with no day-trip crowds overnight
Lake Manapouri crossing and the Wilmot Pass road in, with no aircraft at all
A full middle day exploring remote arms, kayaking or the tender, with a nature guide
Bottlenose dolphins, fur seals and Fiordland crested penguins are all possible. Spring is penguin nesting season (verify)
sw: No aircraft: road and lake crossing
Sails in October and April (projected), inside the sandfly peak
cards.b: About NZD 1,049 per person twin share (Aug 2026–Apr 2027 rate). 2027/28 dates not yet published.

cards.op: From Manapouri · up to 52 guests · May and Aug
sp: Same route as the Wanderer on a larger boat
Private twin cabins with ensuites
Winter: snow on the tops, no sandflies, few other visitors
sw: Sails in May and August, when sandflies are fewer
The Coastal Pacific does not run then
cards.b: About NZD 1,099 per person twin share (May–Aug 2027), plus an optional NZD 41 picnic lunch each.

cards.op: Fiordland Discovery · 1 night · about 20 guests · late Oct–Apr
sp: Milford Sound after the day boats have gone: sunset and sunrise under Mitre Peak
Top-deck hot tub after dinner, with stars if it clears
Three-course dinner with Mt Difficulty wines
Kayaks, tender trips and a seabed camera (ROV)
sw: The most luxurious feel, and the Endeavour cabin has twin king singles
No aircraft needed: drive the Milford Road
Runs late October to April: the sandfly peak
cards.b: From NZD 2,380 per person twin share (Oct–Dec 2026 and Apr 2027 rate). Van transfer extra.

cards.op: Heritage Expeditions · 18 guests · Jan–Apr and Aug
sp: Expert naturalist guides on a true expedition yacht
Dusky Sound: Cook's 1773 Astronomer's Point, Anchor Island, Breaksea Sound
House drinks included, ensuite cabins
sw: Helicopter leg: allowed only because there is no other way in
2028 dates not yet published; 2027 dates are January–April and August
cards.b: Salvin's Twin USD 3,670 per person (Fiordland Explored), converted at 1.70.

cards.op: Southern Fiords Discovery · 18 guests · 19 Sep and 25 Sep 2027
sp: The far south: Preservation and Chalky Inlets, gold-rush and whaling history, Puysegur Point lighthouse
Dusky, Breaksea and Doubtful Sounds in one voyage
Naturalist guides, house drinks
sw: The 19 Sep sailing falls outside the October–April sandfly peak
Depends on the Coastal Pacific running by mid-September
Helicopter leg: allowed only because there is no other way in
cards.b: Salvin's Twin USD 5,110 per person, converted at 1.70. About NZD 13,900 with the 20% offer.

cards.op: After the cruise · by the same means as the drive south
sp: Back through Wanaka and over the Lindis Pass, or straight through in a day
Return to Christchurch for the train north
sw: Direct gets us back in one long day of about 8 hours
Breaking at Wanaka and Tekapo makes it two or three easy days
cards.b: Included in the rental if we drive ourselves. About NZD 3,000 (estimate) if chauffeured.

cards.op: Coastal Pacific, Interislander and Northern Explorer north, from Christchurch
sp: See everything again in the other direction, with a different light and a different season
Another Scenic Plus day or two to relax
sw: Train the full length, both ways
The Coastal Pacific leaves Christchurch at 07:00 and reaches Picton at 12:40, meeting the 14:15 ferry
In spring, the Coastal Pacific runs Thu–Sun only; not at all May–August
cards.b: Scenic Plus on both trains (about 1,000 + 1,000) and the ferry with the Plus lounge (300).
